name: KO-2 heavy stun pistol
description: The KO-2 heavy stun pistol was a type of stun pistol manufactured by Palandrix. It was a favored weapon of law enforcement agencies throughout the galaxy's Core Worlds, and although it was large and intimidating, the KO-2 was manufactured from lightweight but durable alloys and plastics, which gave its frame a sleek, stream-lined appearance. In the hands of a trained professional, the KO-2 was powerful enough to put down a Wookiee in one or two blasts.
